BACKUP.TITLE: Backup
BACKUP.DESCRIPTION: Save the platform data and settings to a backup file

RESTORE.TITLE: Restore
RESTORE.DESCRIPTION: Restore the platform data and settings from a backup file

STORAGE.TITLE: Backup storage
STORAGE.DESCRIPTION: Review, download and remove the backup files in storage

BACKUP.TITLE: Backup

OPTIONS.PASSWORD_HINT: Encrypts the backup; a one-time password is shown when it's ready
OPTIONS.BINARY_HINT: Files and images of the modules that support it

BACKUP.WARN_SECURITY: The backup will contain user accounts and password hashes. Store it securely.
BACKUP.WARN_NO_PASSWORD: The backup will not be encrypted: anyone with the file can read its data.
BACKUP.PASSWORD_NOTE: Copy this password now: it is shown only once and is needed to restore the backup.

RESTORE.TITLE: Restore
RESTORE.EXISTING: Or restore a backup that is already in storage
RESTORE.AUTHOR: Author
RESTORE.PASSWORD_HINT: The password shown when the backup was made
RESTORE.WARN: Restoring overwrites the existing data of the selected modules and sections.

ALERTS.RESTORE_CONFIRMATION: Restore {file}? The existing data of the selected sections will be overwritten. This cannot be undone.
ALERTS.DELETE_BACKUPS: Delete {count} backup file(s)? This cannot be undone.
ALERTS.UPLOAD_NO_RESPONSE: The file was sent but the server never responded. This usually means the file exceeds the upload size limit (often 100 MB). Try a smaller backup, or ask your administrator to raise the limit.
ALERTS.UPLOAD_STALLED: The upload stalled — no data was transferred for a while. Check your network connection and try again.
